additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374786-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002092] Outlet 1 Out of order CRM:00579001031
additional_info.body:
Hello Sascha,
Greetings of the day!
We checked for the logs and error flags and found that- Outlet1 was unavailable.
Currently, following are the error flags:
Here we can see that,
it shows IMD is not receiving Modbus values within 5 seconds and a mismatch between modbus and relay values.
Please plan a site visit to check the IMD settings and all the connections to it. Also please carry one spare IMD with you in case a replacement is needed.
Refer the Knowledge article below to check the IMD-
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_IMD BC_Chargingstation OOO - Dynamics 365
If possible please share the photo of IMD display or let us know what is been displayed on IMD_BC1?
Check for the connections and measurements as per the diagram below. Check if there are any loose wirings through terminals.
Also from the logs, we found that -
Tue, 20 Aug 2024 22:16:50 GMT    2024-08-20, 22:16:46    2024-08-20T22:16:46.148875+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [MBC]
SECC: no comm for 750ms "DC1"
Hence we will suggest you to check connections to KF12 as well.
We will wait for your feedback to proceed further.
Do let us know if you have any other queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
